verdict.rationale: TaxJar is a hosted sales-tax SaaS, and nothing in the pack shows its product source is published under an open license. The GitHub items show only a public API client library (taxjar-node), and none of them state a license. A client SDK is an adjacent building block, not the product's own source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
